title: Far more than service staff;
titleEmphasis: we sail, dive, and move with you.
intro: We select crew for two things: how they handle a boat, and how they make people feel welcome on it. Read their profiles and tell us who you’d like on board.
rolesIntro: We’ll do everything we can to put the people you choose on board. If someone isn’t available on your dates, we’ll tell you before you book and recommend the best match for your preferences.

cta.label: Meet all our Passionate Sea People
